description:
Stake ETH and receive a token fully collateralized which represents your own decentralized pool.

Our platform is designed to provide you with hassle-free access to the best yields available so you can decide the percentage risk in different liquidity protocols. 

Stake any amount of ETH, get daily staking rewards and use your collateralized token across the DeFi ecosystem and L2.

Join us now and cultivate your financial growth in the ever-expanding world of decentralized finance. 🌳🚀


👩🏻‍💻 This hack is awesome because it has all the power of liquid staking protocols as LIDO and Rocket Pool but you can use all of them at the same time deciding the distribution with extra perks:

👉🏻 No third managed like Index services.
👉🏻 More diversification and less risk investment exposure.
👉🏻 Different Pool Portfolios that you can use if you don’t wanna build your own.
how_its_made:
🚀 Web3 Details

👉🏻 Login mechanism: Metamask SDK.
👉🏻 DEX Aggregator: 1inch to execute swaps and rebalancing portfolios.
👉🏻 Branding: Nouns DAO vibes.

🖥️ Web2 build details

👉🏻 Frontend: Next.js and vercel as hosting service.
👉🏻 Design and slides: Figma and Google Slides.

👩🏻‍💻 Smart Contracts

👉🏻 Controller contract owned by StakeGarden, in charge of verifying the protocol is using Liquid Staking tokens, can verify if a pool is part of the protocol and the 1inch aggregator router
👉🏻 PoolFactory: in charge of creating the individual pools
👉🏻 Pool: main logic for pool, deposit, withdrawal and rebalancing
👉🏻 SwapNativeEth: helper contract that implements 1inch logic to purchase liquid staking tokens using ETH before depositing into Pool

Start to cultivate your financial growth in the ever-expanding world of decentralized finance. Enjoy Stake Garden! 🌳💪🏻
